items.title: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys
items.summary: Cybersecurity company Radware says attackers gained access to some of its customers' account details and cloud access keys through an unsecured internal Cloud WAF (Web Application Firewall) management API that was left exposed online. [...]

items.title: VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities
items.summary: The critical bugs include an authentication bypass in vCenter and flaws that could allow code execution on ESX hosts. The post VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.summary: The ShinyHunters extortion gang claims to have returned in posts on a new data leak site after a series of arrests over the past two months targeting alleged members. [...]

items.title: European Commission confirms data theft in EU Academy breach
items.summary: The European Commission, the European Union's main executive body, has confirmed that attackers breached its EU Academy online learning hub and stole the personal data of an undisclosed number of users. [...]

items.title: European Commission Uncovers Data Breach in Cyberattack Investigation
items.summary: Names and email addresses of EU Academy users were exposed in the AI-assisted cyberattack the European Commission detected in October. The post European Commission Uncovers Data Breach in Cyberattack Investigation appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
items.summary: McDonald's Japan, the fast-food giant's Japanese subsidiary, has disclosed a data breach after attackers accessed a database containing sensitive information for users of the company's official smartphone app. [...]

items.title: 1.5 Million Impacted by Data Breach at South Korean Electric Company KEPCO

items.title: Elecbrakes Bluetooth Vulnerabilities Expose Trailers to Forced Braking
items.summary: Critical Bluetooth flaws in Elecbrakes controllers could let nearby attackers force trailer braking, potentially causing accidents. The post Elecbrakes Bluetooth Vulnerabilities Expose Trailers to Forced Braking appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Hackers compromise Check Point Servers in 22 organizations
items.summary: Threat actors have exploited multiple vulnerabilities to compromise two dozen Check Point Security management servers in an ongoing campaign targeting 22 organizations. [...]

items.title: Police disrupt 57 illegal streaming services with 7.3 million visits
items.summary: Law enforcement authorities from 11 countries have disrupted 57 illegal streaming services that operated hundreds of websites and drew over 7.3 million visits each year. [...]

items.title: From Vulnerability Noise to Resilience: Rethinking Security in the AI Era
items.summary: AI-driven development is adding complexity to software supply chains, leaving security teams overwhelmed by vulnerabilities that may pose little actual risk. RapidFort explains how runtime visibility, container hardening, and automated remediation can reduce vulnerability noise and improve software resilience. [...]

items.title: Check Point Security Management Servers Hacked in AI-Assisted Campaign
items.summary: The attacks were launched from 99 IP addresses and targeted organizations across multiple industries and countries. The post Check Point Security Management Servers Hacked in AI-Assisted Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: New Shirudo tool uses AI to shield unpatched Linux systems from exploits
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco launched an open-source Linux security tool named Shirudo that deploys temporary runtime protections to block vulnerability exploitation while administrators prepare and roll out patches, without restarting services. [...]

items.title: Anthropic Expands Enterprise Safeguards for Detecting AI Misuse
items.summary: EFS helps zero-retention customers spot Claude misuse spread across many requests while keeping conversation data in their own cloud. The post Anthropic Expands Enterprise Safeguards for Detecting AI Misuse appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: OpenAI, Cisco Unveil Open Source Tool to Shield Unpatched Linux Systems
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco’s Shirudo uses AI-generated shields to block Linux exploits while patches are prepared, but it’s not yet production-ready. The post OpenAI, Cisco Unveil Open Source Tool to Shield Unpatched Linux Systems appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Peninsula Energy Halts Trading After Cyber Incident Hits US Uranium Mine

items.title: N-able Patches Critical Flaw Discovered After Mail Assure Cyberattack

items.title: AI Agents Are Creating a Shared Responsibility Gap
items.summary: AI agents operate across multiple platforms, creating security gaps when no single vendor can see or control their actions. Token Security examines the shared responsibility problem and explains how organizations can better manage agent identities, permissions, and accountability. [...]

items.title: Microsoft testing fix for Windows 11 Bluetooth audio quality drops
items.summary: Microsoft is working to fix a long-standing Windows issue that has been causing significant audio quality drops for Bluetooth headphone users. [...]

items.title: Le strategie di Cina e Stati Uniti sull’intelligenza artificiale
items.summary: Potenza o efficienza? Mano libera o pianificazione? Modelli aperti o proprietari? Le due superpotenze stanno seguendo strade profondamente diverse nella corsa all’AI. A decretare il vincitore potrebbe però essere un altro elemento: chi riuscirà a sostenerne i costi.
